text:
jordan: quick q — thinking about a narrow-fanout strategy for latency-sensitive endpoints. idea: route to a very small set of hot nodes with preemptive slot reservations that can bump background/batch work. sketch: if req.latency_budget_ms < 50 and region == eu, prefer fanout=3 and preemptable=true. thoughts?

sara: preemption is powerful but dangerous for Dedicated/reserved tenants. need opt-out.

mike: agree. contract: preempt only allowed when tenant_tier != "reserved" and deployment != "private". also need grace window for bumped jobs.

jordan: config sketch:
```
policy:
  id: narrow_fanout_preempt
  match:
    - path_prefix: /generate
      max_latency_ms: 50
  actions:
    fanout: 3
    preempt: true
    preempt_targets: [background_lowprio, cache_warmers]
    canary: 0.1
```

sara: cost angle — preempting might increase short-term util variance, which could spike committed GPU costs. we need cost-safety thresholds.

tina: what about exposing a per-tenant preempt_window (e.g., 30s) so tenants can choose to allow temporary interruptions?

mike: also add an audit + explain API: every preempt decision must emit route.preempted_by and decision_reason for tracing. fallback route must be explicit.

alexa: ops-bot: please send an alert when preemption_rate > 5% for any region during canary. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: alert: policy=narrow_fanout_preempt preemption_rate=12% region=us-west — triggered at 2024-11-03T14:12:01Z

jordan: good catch. another interface question for the policy engine: separate static scoring (policy weights, affinity) from runtime signals (current load, tail-latency). propose API: Evaluate(policy, request, runtime_signals) -> {decision,score,explain}. runtime_signals should be opaque key/value so runtimes can add metrics without changing DSL.

sara: +1. Also the DSL must forbid preempt:true on private deployments and reserved pools by default. explicit override only via enterprise policy and legal sign-off.

mike: perf concerns: need to test p50/p95/p99 with preempt enabled under synthetic backgrounds (cache-warmers + high-batch ingress). compare with hedged-routing baseline.

tina: i'll own perf harness runs. small follow-up: eviction strategy for KV caches when preempting — do we evict LRU or prefer evicting low-similarity keys? eviction choice affects regenerate latencies.

jordan: prefer evicting warm-but-low-similarity keys (keeps hot keys intact). add telemetry hook cache.eviction_reason = preempt_evict to help correlate regressions.

alexa: can we gate with a canary flag so we only enable preempt for 10% of traffic initially? also need rollout playbook if p99 regresses > 5ms.

mike: yep. add rollout plan: canary 10% -> 25% -> 50% with perf gates and auto rollback conditions.

sara: compliance question: show me how we record preempt events for customers who ask for audit logs. we should add a tenant-facing log entry when their background job is preempted.

eng-sre: noted. infra constraints: need dedicated quota for preempt slots and a metric stream for preempted_slots, preemption_rate, and preempt_fallback_count. will file infra ticket.

jordan: thanks — next steps: draft RFC that covers: DSL snippet, engine API (Evaluate + Explain), canary/rollout plan, perf matrix, compliance opt-outs, and telemetry. owners: tina (perf), mike (engine API), sara (compliance + e2e), alexa (rollout/ops). eng-sre to create infra tickets.

mike: i'll start a PR for Evaluate API proposal.

tina: perf jobs scheduled. will post results here.

jordan: i'll open RFC draft and link back. thanks all!
